title: Check wait times for major NSW hospital emergency departments
summary: Use an online search tool to check the expected wait times at major NSW hospital emergency departments.
intro:
NSW Health provides an online search tool as a guide to the expected wait times in the emergency departments of participating major NSW hospitals.

You can find information on the:

The most seriously ill patients are seen immediately. As the information provided is a guide only, it doesn't indicate a specific timeframe or order in which a patient will be seen.

You can use the map options to check surrounding hospitals' information to find alternative emergency departments.

Check emergency department wait times

faqs.q: What does the wait time information mean?
faqs.a: The information provided is a guide only and does not indicate a specific timeframe or the order in which a patient will be seen. The most seriously ill patients are seen immediately.

faqs.q: Can I check wait times for hospitals near me?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use the map options to check surrounding hospitals' information to find alternative emergency departments.

faqs.q: Where can I check the wait times?
faqs.a: You can use the online search tool provided by NSW Health.
